node.statement: Existence on the identical domain: the P-witness guard C_pol^P*(epsilon_r+delta)<=kappa_pol^P permits direct application of lem-stage1-polar-retraction. Its domain is calU times B_delta^{calH}(J), its formula is the same Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H, and its codomain is its image, exactly S_delta:=Pi_delta(calU times B_delta^{calH}(J)) in node 1. Therefore it supplies a bijective C^1 diffeomorphism and a unique two-component inverse on precisely the root domain and image.
